## Executive Summary

State evidence date, scope, proposed recommendation count and quantified coverage.
Link the generated workbook and canonical source.
This is a nonbinding recommendation snapshot, not an approved implementation plan or invoice.

## Action Register

Generate rows from the validated source, including category, task, priority, impact, affected resources,
signed monthly contribution, qualitative effort, notes, comments, proposed status and relative window.
Every row retains action/finding IDs and evidence. Unknown quantities/effort/costs remain explicit.
Lifecycle claims are evidenced; recommendations are not owner-approved remediation.

## Financial Summary

Show additional recurring monthly cost, identified monthly savings and estimated net monthly change
per named scenario, currency and comparable basis. Amounts come only from the canonical calculator.
Separate gross additions from upgrade deltas; do not double-count shared or overlapping benefits.
State exclusions, conditional alternatives and unquantified actions. No total for all-unknown scenarios.

## Basis of Estimate

State currency, region, dates/period, normalization, actual/retail evidence, licensing and usage assumptions,
confidence, rounding reconciliation and shared allocations. Explain conditional/excluded recommendations,
one-time/labor exclusions and relative windows. Neither estimates nor target windows authorize execution.

## Coverage and Limitations

Differentiate no recommendations found from evidence unavailable. List unknowns and missing sources.
The register does not replace the actual-spend Cost Management report, WAF report or architecture diagram.
Do not manufacture compliance, data access, savings or observed implementation progress.

## References

Link the existing reports, workbook, canonical register and retained evidence.
Keep acceptance/review status in the project index and recall outside reviewed bytes.
